name: frontend-kit
description: Systems/dashboard frontend kit for Next.js App Router + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui: scaffold new projects, adopt existing ones, switch shadcn base-color palettes, auto-apply component rules, and review code against them.

default_palette.title: Default shadcn/ui base-color palette
default_palette.description: Default base-color palette for new projects (neutral, zinc, stone, gray, slate, mauve, olive, mist, taupe).

default_accent.title: Default identity accent color
default_accent.description: Accent color preset (blue, emerald, orange, rose, amber, teal, violet) or hex code (#xxxxxx), or 'none'.

default_radius.title: Default border radius scale
default_radius.description: Border radius preset: sharp (0.25rem), default (0.625rem), soft (1rem), or pill.

default_display_font.title: Default display heading font
default_display_font.description: Self-hosted display font name from @fontsource-variable/<name>, or 'none' for default sans.

package_manager.title: Package manager for new projects
package_manager.description: Default package manager when scaffolding new projects (bun, pnpm, npm, yarn).

animation.title: Default animation library
animation.description: Animation library preference for new projects (motion, gsap).
